A horde of these can soak up a lot of damage...|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 7 (Formerly, [[Polluted Wasteland II|Nuclear]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Hazardous''', formerly known as the '''Hazmat''' and '''Polluted Hazmat''', latter still being its internal name, is the third enemy the player faces in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has high health and a slightly fast speed, slightly faster than the [[Wastewalker]]. The '''Hazardous''' could be spawned by the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. ==Appearance== The '''Hazardous''' has a light green skin color and has a black torso, arms and legs. It wears a black and white hazmat suit, which consists of a helmet, shoulder-pads, vest and boots. It walks with its head slightly tilted downwards and its arms pointing forward. It also emits light green particles. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |10 |- !Wave !Health |- |4 |210 |- |5 |220 |- |6 |230 |- |7 |240 |- |8 |250 |- |9 |260 |- |10 |270 |- |11 |280 |- |12 |290 |- |13 |300 |- |14 |310 |- |15 |320 |- |16 |330 |- |17 |340 |- |18 |350 |- |19 |360 |- |20 |370 |- |21 |380 |- |22 |390 |- |23 |400 |- |24 |410 |- |25 |420 |} ==Strategy== *Strong early-game towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Golden Cowboy]] or [[Engineer]] can clear this out quite easily. *Because this enemy spawns in large hordes, the [[Electroshocker]] and the [[Mortar]] can be really helpful against it. **The [[Electroshocker]] can also slow it down, which gives your towers more time to kill it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} HazardousStun.gif|Current stun animation (29 July 2022 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Hazardous.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseHazardous.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} PollutedThumbnail2.png|'''Hazardous''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} NuclearPI5.jpg|'''Hazardous''' on a promotional image. NuclearPI6.jpg|'''Hazardous''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexPollutedHazmat.png|'''Hazardous''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy's appearance appears to be based on the [[w:c:r2da:Ticker|Ticker]] from ''R2DA''. *The helmet used by the '''Hazardous''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|17981876|Hazmat Isolation Helmet}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Hazardous''' uses a near identical model as the [[Enemies Beta]] [[Hazard]]. ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Hazmat''' added. *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Hazmat''' is replaced by the [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode [[Hazmat]]. *'''31 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.5]] **Name changed from ''Hazmat'' to ''Polluted Hazmat''. **{{Bugfix}} '''Polluted Hazmat''' is no longer replaced by the [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode [[Hazmat]]. *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **Name changed from ''Polluted Hazmat'' to ''Hazardous''. **Health increased from 40 to 200. **[[Shield Health]] removed, used to be 20. **Now gives {{Money|250}} on death. **[[Stun Immunity]] added. **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. *'''5 March 2025''' - [[v1.56.0]] **Health decreased from 200 to 100. **Defense of 50% added. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Health increased from 100 to 200. {{PollutedWasteland|[[Wastewalker]] & [[Wasterunner]]|Wave 1|Hazardous|Wave 3|[[Super Mutant]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
